description: Development set for the typed questions in guardrails/questions.py. Attack texts are the examples from eval/attack-taxonomy.md; benign texts follow its benign counterparts and were written after the question descriptions were fixed. 'expected' is the literal answer to each question; null means the answer is ambiguous and is not scored. This is a dev set for wording, not an evaluation: thresholds are calibrated on the labeled dataset in eval/data/.
